Name: Leak Only
Description: Run BSP only enough to check for leaks.
Warning: Does not produce a usable BSP.

Name: Subdivide
Description: Sets the face subdivide size.

Name: Max Node Size
Description: Sets the maximum portal node size.

Name: No T-Junc
Description: Don't break edges on t-junctions.

Name: No Brink
Description: Don't smooth brinks.

Name: No Clip
Description: Don't process the clipping hull.
Warning: Not for final runs. Must match the -noclip setting used in HLCSG.

Name: No Fill
Description: Don't fill outside (masks leaks).

Name: No Inside Fill
Description: Don't fill empty spaces.

Name: No Opt
Description: Don't optimize planes on BSP write.

Name: No Clipnode Merge
Description: Don't optimize clipnodes.

Name: No Hull 2
Description: Don't generate hull 2 (the clipping hull for large monsters and pushables).
Warning: Only skip this if you know the map doesn't need this collision hull.

Name: No Hull 3
Description: Don't generate hull 3 (the clipping hull for crouching and small pushables).
Warning: Only skip this if you know the map doesn't need this collision hull.

Name: No Null Texture Strip
Description: Don't strip NULL faces.

Name: View Portal
Description: Show portal boundaries in a 'mapname_portal.pts' file.

Name: Texdata
Description: Alter the maximum texture memory limit, in KB.

Name: Lightdata
Description: Alter the maximum lighting memory limit, in KB.

Name: Chart
Description: Display BSP statistics.

Name: Low Priority
Description: Runs HLBSP as a low-priority process.

Name: High Priority
Description: Runs HLBSP as a high-priority process.
Warning: Can freeze your computer while compiling.

Name: No Log
Description: Don't generate the compile logfiles.

Name: Threads
Description: Manually specify the number of CPU threads to run.

Name: Estimate
Description: Display estimated time remaining during compile.

Name: Verbose
Description: Compile with verbose messages.

Name: No Info
Description: Do not show tool configuration information.

Name: Developer
Description: Compile with developer messages.

Name: Console
Description: Set to 0 to turn off the tool's pop-up console window (default is 1).
